_comment: Copy-paste reference for manual setup. Merge these two top-level keys into your ~/.claude/settings.json — do not overwrite the file wholesale if you already have other statusLine or hooks.Stop configuration. Replace "node" with an absolute path (e.g. `command -v node`) if your Claude Code hook shell doesn't have node on PATH. See capture/README.md.

_ifYouAlreadyHaveAStatusline._comment: If statusLine.command is already set to something else, point it at statusline-wrapper.cjs instead, and save your original command into ~/.claude/scripts/statusline-original.json so the wrapper can still delegate to it.
